verdicts.reason: Both cram the photo strip into a tiny sliver at the top, with dot grids overlapping it. In both, the '&' runs into the top edge and crowds the 'Baby Toddler' text, and most of the 160x600 canvas is empty navy. A pushes 'BEDDING' to the bottom edge, about 500px from 'Baby Toddler', so the brand name reads as two unrelated pieces with stray dots in the void between them. B puts 'BEDDING' in the middle between the dot columns, which is closer and a bit more deliberate, but it still leaves the lower half dead and the hierarchy weak.
